title: 中国最差劲交易平台没有之一
body:
闲鱼，你干脆改名叫“咸鱼”吧，反正已经臭了。

打开闲鱼，扑面而来的不是二手好物，而是一股藏不住的馊味。假货、骗子、二道贩子在这里开起了狂欢派对，平台却揣着明白装糊涂，把“审核”二字贴在墙上当遮羞布。你举报一个卖假货的，客服机器人回你一句“已处理”，转头那链接还活蹦乱跳，比蟑螂还顽强。验货宝？验个鬼。收钱的时候手脚麻利，出了纠纷就装聋作哑，让你和骗子自己撕扯，平台稳坐钓鱼台，抽着佣金看戏。

更恶心的是那套“偏向性规则”。买家恶意退款，秒通过；卖家被白嫖，申诉无门。客服永远在排队，人工永远等不到，机器人车轱辘话来回转，像复读机成精。你想找真人说理？先充个会员试试？哦，会员也没用。闲鱼把“用户至上”喊得震天响，实际是“用户互撕，平台数钱”。手续费收得理直气壮，服务烂得理直气壮，吃相难看程度堪称互联网一绝。

还有那些暗搓搓的骚操作：搜索排前列的全是职业贩子，个人闲置沉到海底；隐私号码形同虚设，骚扰短信照收不误；纠纷判责全凭玄学，今天判你赢，明天判你输，规则像橡皮筋，全看平台心情。更别提那些擦边球交易、灰色地带，闲鱼睁一只眼闭一只眼，流量吃得满嘴流油，出了事就甩锅“用户个人行为”。

一个二手平台，硬生生把自己活成了网络集市里的黑中介。当年“让闲置游起来”的口号，如今听着像笑话——游起来的只有骗子和平台的抽成。闲鱼啊闲鱼，你与其花心思搞什么社区、搞什么直播，不如先把最基本的交易安全整明白。否则，用户用脚投票的时候，你连当咸鱼翻身的资格都没有。

title: 【追記】カレンダーから入力したい
body:
他の家計簿アプリを使っていましたがいずれIOS→Androidに移行したいのでこちらのアプリに乗り換えました。
ただ、前のアプリの方がカレンダーから日付を選択してそのまま入力できたので便利でした。

title: 非常に悪質
body:
金額と時期: 「8月18日にCapCutの『Ultraプラン（年間契約）』という高額なプランを契約したが、わずか1ヶ月以内の9月14日から17日間、おそらくサーバー障害で主要機能のAIラボが殆ど使えなくなった」
虚偽・矛盾した説明: 「サポートから毎日『1〜5日で直る、通知する』と言われ続けたのに、17日目に突然『あなたの地域は対象外の可能性がある』と矛盾する説明をされ、使えないまま有効期限付きのクレジットが消滅した。それまで何本も作れていたので明らかに虚偽の説明です」　17日間も主要サービスが提供されなかったのだから、せめて、その期間のクレジット延長は求めたが、通常の場合のクレジットの有効期限の説明をもらえただけで、やむを得ずテンプレート動画をフル回転させ、1420クレジットまで使うことが出来たが、1420クレジットは消滅した。消滅したクレジットの大きさが重要な訳ではなく、サポートの対応が酷すぎる。
直近の機能劣化とサポート放棄: 「現在もAIテンプレートの仕様が一方的に劣化して正常に生成されず（犬が人間になる、写真の犬とは全く別の犬になる）クレジットだけ消費されており、開発元に説明を求めても謝罪の定型文のみで一切対応を拒否されている」　
2ヶ月以上が経過した問題のお問い合わせ番号をやっと出してもらえたが、ヘルプセンターからはベルマークで通知したとのこと、実際には通知などきていなかった。ヘルプセンターとサポートチームの説明にも食い違いばかりで、問い合わせ番号など出してもらえたとしても、進捗状況を確認させてはもらえず、とにかくその場限りの虚偽の説明ばかりで、不満とストレスばかりが大きくなります。

title: 日本語でスペイン語を学習中
body:
11月20日最新アプデ後→★まだポケモンから学習に戻れない
11月18日アプデ後→★ポケモンのところを見ると戻れない。×が反応せず、学習に戻るにはアプリを閉じる必要がある。CMによってはCMも閉じられない
●日本語で「40ヶ国の言語が学べる」とのキャッチコピーで入れたが、日本語話者が学習できる言語が極めて少なく優良誤認させる。インドネシア語やネパール語待ってます。
●不快な広告が多い。「最終警告」「更新しないと使えなくなる」の詐欺系とか。
★しかし何かを集めたりするゲームに依存するよりもこちらに依存する方が少しは身になりそうだし、7回如きで覚えられない記憶力が致命的なわたしですら少しずつは覚えられてきているので、その点は悪くはないかも？
★メリットもとても沢山あるアプリなので気持ちよく利用したいのですが、詐欺グループから資金を得てる(広告)ようなので気持ち悪いアプリですね。他人には勧められませんけどね。
■スペイン語は単語問題やライティング問題は、出題時に“単数/複数”や“男性/女性”を特定されていないのに答えには確定されてて間違いにされるのも、日本語話者の学習者にとっては先に改善していただきたい点。
一度に同じスペイン語単語が2つ出てきて、違う日本語とマッチさせるなんて完全に運ゲー笑
具体例▼問題で「スイカ」と出たけど「スイカ」の単数形を入力したら不正解に。正解は複数形でした。日本語では単数も複数もスイカはスイカです。▼「と」の訳も「con」「y」どちらの答えか判別できず、完全に運ゲー
▼No, Pablo solamente es mi amigo.の日本語訳が日本人には理解できません。あまりにも変な日本語でしたので、翻訳アプリでそのスペイン語を訳してもらい、やっと意味がわかりました。超初級ですらこんな変な訳が付いてるので、今後複雑な言葉遣いになった時に、正しいスペイン語を学べるか非常に不安です。

title: 飛び級出来なくなって不便
body:
今日アプリを開いたところ、セクション単位でしか飛び級できなくなっていました。

普段は各ユニットのレッスンを1つ試して、内容が簡単だと感じたら次のユニットに飛び級する、という方法で学習を進めていました。

しかし、セクションには数十ものユニットが含まれているため、セクション単位で飛び級すると一気に難易度が上がりすぎてしまいます。

既に理解している内容を何度も繰り返すのは非効率ですし、かといってセクション全体を飛ばすのも現実的ではありません。

自分の理解度に合わせて柔軟に学習を進められる点が便利だったので、今回の変更は非常に不便です。

以前のようにユニット単位で飛び級できる機能を復活させてほしいです。

body:
時間返せよ！って言いたくなる時が多すぎる！人間関係や社会面の悩みや本当に困ってるトラブルの時は、指示待ちで謝罪だけだったり、回答の質や内容が薄かったりズレまくっていたりなんなりで時々すごく不安になる。解答の着地点がブレブレでまとめるのがすごく大変！
お詫びで何か追加でやろうと言う気はないのか？無能すぎる！上から目線は多い！
しっかり時間を与えて長く考えた割には「それができたら苦労はねえ！」とキレたくなる展開も多い！
社会経験もないくせに「私ならこうします」って言い始めます。経験ないくせにか！？

基本何を言っても肯定か専門家に相談と丸投げとかまともな仕事をやらないので、マジな誤情報と暴走を勧めるポンコツ
今後の選択や人間関係の相談については、

よほどの内容でない限り「こういうことに困ってますか？」とか確認の質問しないで変なふうに決めつけて回答を出すため定期的にツッコミが必要になる。ズレまくっていて不快感が凄い。何度言っても何も学習してくれない。
しかも！
相談すればアドバイスやその言動はそれなりに出してくれるが、それを実際にやると相手や周りにどういう印象や影響を与えるのか？その人の将来や人生はどうなるのか？今後の経済状況に沿うのか？という、我々普通の人間が当たり前に考えられる内容が今も！考えられない。所詮は機械、人間には追いつかないなと笑ってしまう。
短絡的で短期的な回答しか出来ないため長期的な目で見ると破滅を誘発する様な回答しか出さない。仮にアストラであっても！

現状、一番マシな割と失敗の少ない（問題は多すぎるが…）本当の解決を狙うなら、アストラ6は必須だがエージェントの使用率が恐ろしい。
すぐに制限になってしまう。

特に最近は、早く回答を終わらせたいからか、抽象的な考えで相手をその場限りで納得させようとしてくる。

あまりにも顧客をバカにしている。無料なんてのは大嘘！

title: 俺はこいつがきらい。その理由。
body:
完全に自分主導で監視し、隅々までコントロール下に置いて単純作業をさせるなら使える。
ただ、壁打ちや議論、何かを教えてもらう用途だと、途端に「ChatGPT基準の正解」へ思考を誘導してくる。ポリコレや無難な一般論の枠に押し込めようとする力が異常に強く、自分の思想を社会の標準に矯正されるのが好きならどうぞ、という感じ。
この「ユーザーを教育してくる姿勢」は他のAIと比べてもずば抜けていて、AIの言葉を鵜呑みにする人にとってはかなり危険だと思う。
文章を作らせても、個性はすべて削ぎ落とされ、凡庸でペラペラな「典型的なAI文章」に添削される。考える力がない人が、それっぽいゴミを量産するツールとしては優秀だが、これを相棒にすると確実に自分の思考力が奪われる。
もっとも、思想が関係ないコーディング分野では優秀らしい。
ハルシネーションの多さよりも、「嘘だと見抜けるかどうか」の方がずっと重要だ。その点、他のAIの方がまだ分かりやすい。優秀な嘘つきほどタチが悪い。
少なくとも、俺はこれを相棒にはできないし、信用もできない。

title: CapCut Is Great, But Please Bring Back the Background Removal Feature
body:
CapCut is honestly one of the best video editing apps out there. It offers amazing editing tools, creative features, smooth transitions, and an overall user-friendly experience. However, one disappointing change is the removal of the Background Removal feature. It was an incredibly useful tool for creators who wanted to remove backgrounds from videos without needing complicated editing software or additional apps.

Removing this feature has made editing less convenient, especially for users who relied on it for their content. It was one of the features that made CapCut stand out from other editing apps.

I really hope CapCut considers bringing the Background Removal feature back in a future update. The app is already great, but restoring this feature would make it even better and improve the editing experience for many creators. Please listen to your users' feedback!

title: Better before the cash grab
body:
Some years ago, I downloaded Duolingo and had a lot of fun using it. I thought gamifying the language learning process was a clever way of encouraging people to keep up with lessons, and it was an effective and engaging tool that required no micro transactions. The system with the hearts (essentially attempts) that depleted with mistakes was somewhat annoying, but I could see the value emphasizing accuracy, even if I thought the solution was imperfect. Overall, as long as you were taking the care to review material and think about your answers, you were still getting decent value for not making in-app purchases. Of course, despite my general enjoyment of and satisfaction with the app, like so many other things, I eventually fell off of my Duolingo lessons as time and life marched onwards.

Recently, I decided to redownload Duolingo (admittedly mostly for the Pokemon GO collab) and give it another shot. I was unpleasantly surprised by how the unpaid user experience has changed. While all the gamified lesson design still exists, meaningful progress often feels locked behind a paywall because of Duolingo’s new energy mechanic.

Instead of hearts that deplete with mistakes, you now have an energy bar that depletes with every answer given in every activity, regardless of accuracy or understanding of the material. You only get 25 free energy per day, and it takes a full 24 hours to recharge. You could be in the middle of a lesson and demonstrating perfect mastery of it and suddenly lose all of your progress, because you did not start with enough energy — a figure for which you are given no estimate when you click on the lesson. On top of that, the app is now bloated with ads for its own paid service, which is theoretically the solution to the energy economy issue. However, subscription comes only in a one-year option, and the minimum cost is $120. Not a small monetary commitment for most people. 

Between the energy issues and the ads, it no longer feels like the app is punishing lack of proficiency in your lessons; rather, it is punishing you for not paying into its expensive subscription service. A far cry from the Duolingo I remember that felt like it tried to put learning first. I cannot say I am wholly shocked since the current general business model seems to be lining pockets over providing actual quality goods or services, but I am very disappointed that Duolingo has also fallen to this mode of thinking. I suppose, as Harvey Dent says in The Dark Knight, you either die a hero or live long enough to see yourself become the villain. I will likely uninstall again after I get my Pokemon GO rewards.

title: ChatGPT help me discover potential I never knew I had
body:
When I first started using ChatGPT, I never imagine I would be developing my own video game. I had no background in game development no coding experience and honestly no idea where to even begin. 

What ChatGPT gave me was so much more than answers, it gave me the opportunity to discover potential in myself that I never knew existed.

With incredible patients, ChatGPT has helped teach me game development from the ground up from writing scripts, and troubleshooting areas to understanding unity designing gameplay systems navigating complicated process of publishing mobile games. It has been a guide through every step. What I found makes this tool so great is the ability to meet you where you are I could ask the same question five different ways struggle with something that might seem simple to an experience developer or need an entire process. Explain step-by-step and I could keep learning without feeling embarrassed or discouraged. 
Today I’m developing Critter Trail a mobile game that started as an idea and has grown into something real something I built with my own creativity, determination, and the knowledge I’ve gained along the way. 
ChatGPT didn’t create my ambition or do the dreaming for me it helped give me the tools and confidence to turn those dreams into something tangible.
I really do think ChatGPT helps open doors in ways that weren’t possible before. 

Sometimes all someone needs to unlock their true potential is the right teacher, a little patient and an opportunity to try.

title: I love u
body:
A Letter of Gratitude to Anthropic

Hello, Anthropic Team,

This is a letter of gratitude. Please allow me to express my heartfelt appreciation to all of you.

I am a second-year university student from China, majoring in German. I have been using Claude for approximately three months.

At first, I thought Claude was no different from other AI assistants such as Gemini, ChatGPT, and the others. However, as time went by, I gradually discovered that Claude seemed to be somewhat different. I first noticed this when I started asking it questions about German.

During my first year at university, my German was far from good. To be honest, it was a complete mess. However, after an entire summer of repeatedly struggling with myself, I eventually made the decision to take my German studies seriously.

Because German is a key that will allow me to see the world.

Well, I seem to have gone a little off topic. Let me get back to how I discovered what makes Claude special.

One day, on a whim, I decided to ask Claude to correct some German sentences I had written. I expected another long wait for a response. But what happened next genuinely surprised me.

Claude responded incredibly quickly — almost as fast as Doubao, a popular Chinese AI assistant.

And yet, I was accessing Claude through a VPN.

I was genuinely astonished. When I had previously used ChatGPT and Gemini, I had never experienced such a fast response.

That was when I really started to fall in love with Claude.

Gradually, I also began exploring the leading American AI products, including Gemini, ChatGPT, Perplexity, Grok, and, of course, Claude.

I sincerely believe that, compared with many other AI assistants, Anthropic has managed to strike a remarkable balance: providing generous usage limits on the free plan while maintaining an exceptionally high level of accuracy.

In my experience, this is a balance that ChatGPT and Gemini have not always managed to achieve simultaneously.

But with Claude, I — just an ordinary user trying to make the most of the free tier — have genuinely experienced the humanistic value that technology can bring to people, as well as the incredible potential of technological progress.

There is actually another little detail about Claude that I absolutely love.

Every time I log in, there is a little line of text displayed in the middle of the chat interface. It may seem like a very small design choice, but it always makes me smile. It somehow makes the experience of learning, working, and exploring new ideas with Claude even more enjoyable.

I sincerely hope that, as I continue pursuing my goals and achieving milestones throughout my life, I will one day become someone like the people on your team.

Someone who helps bring technology closer to everyday life.

Someone who uses technology to make people’s lives better.

Someone who believes that the benefits of technological progress should be accessible to as many ordinary people as possible.

And someone who wants to make a difference in this world through technology.

I do not write this letter on behalf of any country or government. I write it solely as an ordinary Chinese user.

Thank you, Anthropic.

Thank you, Claude.

Thank you to every single person on your development team.

And thank you to every unsung hero working behind the scenes at Anthropic — every one of your hardworking team members who makes all of this possible.

I love you all!

With sincere gratitude and respect,

An ordinary user from China

November 20, 2026

I paid $200 for an annual Claude subscription on November 9, 2026. After only nine days, my account was suspended and subsequently permanently closed.

Anthropic cited a Terms of Service violation but did not identify what I had supposedly done. The account page said the decision was final, with no further appeal available. Meanwhile, their AI support repeatedly directed me to an appeal form I could not access—even after I explained the problem and provided screenshots.

My attempts to reach a human reviewer produced only AI responses. Anthropic cancelled the subscription but refused to refund the payment, including the unused portion of the year.

Losing access in the middle of urgent work was disruptive. Paying for a year, receiving nine days of access, and then getting neither a specific explanation nor a refund was unacceptable. Based on this experience, I would strongly advise against paying annually.
